title: Cross-Image Relational Knowledge Distillation for Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Distil pixel-to-pixel and pixel-to-region relations across images using memory banks.
adaptation: Benchmark KD baseline; memory bank across cells of all 5 sources; compare with logit KD at matched GPU-h.
min_experiment: Benchmark-only: CIRKD student vs logit-KD student at matched GPU-h; metric crack IoU, mIoU_rob. Kill (for score use): below logit KD.
evidence: R: student gains on Cityscapes, CamVid, ADE20K, VOC; canonical-KD paper (2604.25530) shows it loses to plain KD at matched compute.
